title: GTA 6 tech will speed up Rockstar's next game 🚀
subject: gta6
description:
What should Rockstar make after GTA 6? 👇

In Bloomberg's October 14 feature on the making of GTA 6, Rockstar studio heads Phil Hooker and Aaron Garbut said the engine, tools and team built for the game will let the studio's next project come together faster than the eight-year gap since Red Dead Redemption 2. No next game has been announced. GTA 6 launches November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Sources: Bloomberg (Oct 14, 2026), VGC (Oct 14, 2026), Push Square (Oct 14, 2026)
Game images © Rockstar Games.

scenes.text: Rockstar says its next game won't take eight years.
Studio heads Phil Hooker and Aaron Garbut told Bloomberg GTA 6's engine, tools and team will carry over.
Garbut said the studio rebuilt its foundations for this game. "But now it's done, and we're not going to rip it apart."
Part of the wait was research: the team rode with Miami police and studied the city's light from helicopters.
No next game is named yet. GTA 6 launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
